'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship Jacob Mayer DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Mayer]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jake Mayer
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
